summary: Three assigned administration fixture E2E cases still assert the retired standalone Integrations navigation/page after Issue #238 moved service status under Policies.

source_chain.observation: Company Admin navigation assertion still requires an Integrations link.
Legacy /integrations is opened and the retired Integrations & Connectors presentation is expected.
Cross-scope race test opens /integrations and expects the retired Integrations & Connectors heading.
Current MD-02 navigation registrations contain no Integrations destination.
Legacy /integrations route redirects with replace semantics to /policies?tab=services.
Current accepted test explicitly expects no Integrations nav and validates the Service Status compatibility redirect.

impact: These stale fixture E2E assertions can fail or exercise the wrong UI contract when the legacy/default E2E suite is run, reducing regression-suite confidence. Prime independently confirmed the current CI runtime E2E gate targets ./e2e-runtime, so this is not presently evidenced as a CI gate blocker.
competing_explanations: The stale specs are outside the current CI runtime E2E testDir and may be retained only as legacy/manual coverage.
A test-only routing layer could theoretically alter behavior, but the production route plus the newer Issue #238 E2E encode the same replacement contract.
recommended_followup: Prime/owner should reconcile the legacy assertions with the accepted Service Status behavior under UI Freeze. No test or source edits were made.
